prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A 3D-rendered cartoon character in the style of a glossy CGI children's animated series: a chubby, baby-like giraffe with a soft, rounded, pear-shaped body, smooth bright butter-yellow skin like matte vinyl, a pale cream round belly, stubby little arms and short stumpy legs. It has an oversized round head with puffy cheeks, a thick, slightly elongated neck, a few soft caramel-brown giraffe patches on its back, neck and the top of its head, two small rounded knobby horns, small floppy ears, and a short tail with a dark tuft. The giraffe stands upright like a toddler and is bursting into uproarious, mocking laughter: head thrown back, mouth stretched enormously wide open showing a smooth pink tongue and dark red mouth interior, eyes squeezed shut into thick upward-curving black arcs, tiny tears of laughter at the corners of its eyes, one stubby hand pointing straight at the viewer and the other clutching its jiggling belly. Close-up, front-facing, slightly low-angle shot, with the character filling most of a square frame. Plain, softly blurred pastel background, bright, even, cheerful lighting, soft shadows and saturated colors. It should look like a screenshot from a kids' cartoon used as an internet reaction image, exaggerated and comically smug. No text, no captions, no watermark.
